## v0.6.0 — Every line, every lens, and your nightly camera reports on the dashboard

This release fills in the rest of the dashboard. Every counting line you draw
now gets its own card, your cameras' nightly statistics reports show up as
cards, and live crowd and slip-&-fall detection are wired through end to end.
It also fixes a batch of quiet failures that could leave a newly added camera
half-configured.

### What's new
- **Each counting line gets its own card.** Draw two lines on the same camera
  and you now get two separate cards — one per line — instead of the two
  collapsing into a single combined count.
- **Your nightly camera reports, as dashboard cards.** The daily statistics
  your cameras already upload (people counting, vehicle counting, queue
  management, crowd counting) can now be added straight to the dashboard as
  trend cards, alongside everything else.
- **Live crowd counting.** Cameras that report crowd levels now feed a Crowd
  Count card that shows the day's peak.
- **Slip-&-fall alerts.** Cameras with slip-&-fall detection now surface a
  Slip & Fall card so you can keep an eye on incidents.
- **Multi-sensor cameras deliver on every lens.** Each lens on a multi-sensor
  camera now reliably reports its own crossings and dwell, so a four-sensor
  camera fills in all four sensors instead of only the first.

### Fixes & polish
- **Reports now load reliably.** Fixed an issue that could stop a camera's
  uploaded reports from being saved, which left report cards empty.
- **Previously used cameras connect cleanly.** Fixed three silent failures
  that could leave a re-used camera stuck on "needs attention" — the live
  events connection, the secure certificate install when a camera's
  certificate store was full, and a misreported report setup step now all
  surface and resolve correctly.
- **Removing a camera leaves nothing behind.** Deleting a camera now fully
  clears its zones, cards, reports, and history so the next camera you add
  starts from a clean slate.

No action is required to upgrade. Existing dashboards keep working, and the
new card types are available immediately from the dashboard.
